spans.title: Gifts With the Morning Milk
spans.blurb: A fine meerschaum pipe appears on a detective's doorstep with no card. He knows exactly who sent it, and exactly what he is going to do about it.

spans.title: When Your Eyelid Twitches
spans.blurb: A detective lists the week's peculiar accidents: burning pants, a scorched getaway driver, a bomb that failed. The calm man across the desk is not curious at all.
spans.spoilerNote: It shows Brink knowingly behind the criminals' impossible mishaps, something the full story unfolds more gradually.

books.pairNote: Separate episodes of the same feud, no shared text and neither steals the other's payoff.

spans.title: An Audience With the Inquisitor
spans.blurb: A man accused of witchcraft demands to see the Inquisitor himself. He has one demonstration to make, and torture waits on the other side of failure.

spans.title: The Stolen Kiss
spans.blurb: For days he has kept the madness leashed. Then, in the space of a finger-snap, he seizes her, and waits in agony for her to speak.

spans.title: Right of Way
spans.blurb: A big steamer breaks the rules of the road to pinch a yacht against a reef, with fog rolling in fast. Then the owner starts giving orders.

spans.title: The Breaking of the Bow
spans.blurb: A king presents a bow that gods, fiends and titans have failed to bend, then invites a young prince to try before the assembled thousands of his court.

spans.title: Two Days Too Late
spans.blurb: A man returns from years abroad, rich at last, to find the woman he loves newly engaged. He confronts her betrothed with a question neither can escape.

spans.title: Half Past Three
spans.blurb: An officer strikes matches under his macintosh, counting the minutes until his men charge the trenches in darkness, wondering how many will answer roll call tomorrow.

spans.title: A Mare for a Chain
spans.blurb: A farmer who brags about his horse trades takes a shine to a young peddler's neck chain. The peddler, very reluctantly, lets himself be talked into a swap.

spans.title: Beowulf and Grendel
spans.blurb: A hero vows to face a night-fiend bare-handed in a great hall no man has survived after dark. When everything is still, the monster comes.

spans.title: The Burglar in Blue Calico
spans.blurb: Someone is climbing through the back window with great care. Mrs. Dering tiptoes around the corner expecting a burglar and finds something far more drenched.

spans.title: The Empty Place at Supper
spans.blurb: Supper is called, the cakes are hot, and one sister does not answer. As the clock strikes on through the night, four girls grow quietly frightened.

books.pairNote: A comic soaking and an anxious night vigil, different scenes and different sisters.

spans.title: The Lantern on the Semaphore
spans.blurb: A boy climbs a semaphore with an old switch lantern to flash a telegraph warning across the dark, while angry men race to pull him down.
